item.description:
Quiet background tabs, card descriptions, folder fix and full Cmd-P

  • A workspace you are not looking at no longer jumps to the front when it opens a tab. You get a notification and a plum dot on that workspace instead.
  • Double-clicking the window header zooms the window, like a normal title bar (it follows your System Settings choice).
  • The Board review list is now called "Need You", for new and existing boards.
  • The card window folds long attachment groups. Click a group header to open or close it.
  • Board AI writes a ticket-style description (Summary, Context, Scope, Acceptance criteria, Links) for cards with an empty description. It never replaces your own text. At most 6 automatic writes per hour.
  • A workspace folder now follows the repo its agent works in. "+" opens in the focused tab's folder. Right-click a workspace tab and choose "Change Folder…" to fix a wrong folder.
  • Cmd-P now lists every command, including Copy URL, Find, focus pane up/down and Image Optimizer pause/resume.
  • The old GitHub repository dashboard (already hidden) and its code are removed.
